question: The value of [(24 - 12) ÷ 4] + [81 - 48 ÷ 12 of 2] is
solution:
**Given:**

[(24 - 12) ÷ 4] + [81 - 48 ÷ 12 of 2]

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ [(24 - 12) ÷ 4] + [81 - 48 ÷ 12 of 2] 

⇒ [12 ÷ 4] + [81 - 48 ÷ 24] (Of will be solved first according to BODMAS)

⇒ 3 + [81 - 48 ÷ 24] 

⇒ 3 + [81 - 2] 

⇒ ​3 + 79

⇒ 82

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
